Marketplace product update synchronization

API for updating products registered on marketplaces.

get https://apiweb.shoplinker.co.kr/ShoplinkerApi/Product/MallSendUpdate.php?iteminfo_url=XML_URL[URL-encoded]&type=TYPE_VALUE
  • When type is 001, synchronize updates by marketplace product code [1:1 method]
  • When type is 002, synchronize updates using your own management code [1:N method]

Request Parameters

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. Required customer_id string Customer code (Shoplinker registration code) Code issued by Shoplinker
ex) a0000001
2. mall_product_id string Marketplace product code When type is 001 Required input value.
3. partner_product_id string Customer product code (product management code) When type is 002 Required input value.
4. Required sale_status string Sale status Allowed values
  1. - On sale : 001
  2. - Sales suspended : 003
  3. - Sold out : 004
  4. - Delete : 005
  5. - Sales ended : 006
5. market_price integer Marketplace list price
6. Required sale_price integer Marketplace sale price
7. supply_price integer Marketplace supply price
8. market_price_p integer Supplier market price
9. sale_price_p integer Supplier selling price
10. supply_price_p integer Supplier supply price
11. Required quantity integer Product quantity
12. opt_info string Option information 1. With one option field [color]
Example: OptionTitle||OptionAttribute^^Quantity<**>Price,OptionAttribute^^Quantity<**>Price,repeat..
Color||black^^10<**>1000,yellow^^20<**>2000,..

2. With two option fields [color-size] - combinations
Example: OptionTitle1/OptionTitle2||OptionAttribute1/OptionAttribute2^^Quantity<**>Price,OptionAttribute1/OptionAttribute2^^Quantity<**>Price,repeat..
Color/size||black/xl^^10<**>0,black/L^^20<**>1000,black/m^^30<**>1000...

* If option attributes contain '/', '(', ')', '|', spaces, or similar characters
An error occurs during product synchronization.
13. maker string Manufacturer name
14. brand_nm string Brand name
15. model_nm string Model name
16. product_name string Product name
17. keyword string Keywords
18. origin string Country of origin name/code Enter either the exact country of origin name or its code. e.g. South Korea OR APIORIGIN_031
19. auth_no string Certification number
20. detail_desc string Detailed description
21. desc_type_tag string Product tags and detailed description
22. shoplinker_link_type string Updates only products linked to Shoplinker Allowed values - Sales status : S Applies when updating only the status of products linked to Shoplinker, without marketplace synchronization
23. linker_type string Partial product synchronization Allowed values
  • - Price synchronization : P
  • - Option synchronization : O
  • - Sales status synchronization : S
 As more marketplaces have been added, this has been consolidated into partial marketplace synchronization. Use that option for integration.
24. lclass_id string Shoplinker level 1 product category code Refer to the Excel data
25. item_seq string Item detail code Refer to the Excel data
26. item_info string Item detailed description Refer to the Excel data
27. model_mo string Model NO
28. product_description string Product summary description
29. ImageLink string Image update Allowed values
  1. - Disabled : NULL
  2. - Enabled : Y
Send original product images to marketplaces (Auction, Gmarket, 11st, and WCONCEPT only)
30. weight string Weight Digits only; decimal points are not allowed
ex)11
31. product_name_delv string Product name for shipping labels Used as a short product name when printing waybills.
(Not synchronized to the marketplace.)
32. adult_info string Adult product Allowed values
  1. - Adult product : Y
  2. - Not an adult product : N
32. unit_price ▼ object Unit price information Click to expand child fields.
ㄴ type string Unit price input method Allowed values
  1. - Default input : default
  2. - Manual input : manual
ㄴ totalCapacity string Total capacity Example: numbers such as 1000, 2000 Required when type is default
ㄴ unitCapacity string Unit capacity Example: numbers such as 10, 20 Required when type is default
ㄴ indicationUnit string Display unit Example: g, kg, ml, L, cm, m, piece, pieces per pack, sheet, sheets per pack, item, capsule, gummy, sachet, ball Required when type is default
ㄴ direct_input_text string Manually entered text Total capacity / displayed capacity / display unit (e.g. 100/10/kg) Required when type is manual

Response

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. result bool Result flag Allowed values
  1. - Success : true
  2. - Failure : false
2. product_id string Shoplinker product code Shoplinker product code
ex) prod0001213
3. message string Result message Success or failure message 
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="euc-kr" ?>
<Shoplinker>;
	<ResultMessage>
		<result>true</result>
		<product_id>P012545</product_id>
		<message>수정성공</message>
	</ResultMessage>
</Shoplinker>
